The LLM Exchanges screen shows the record of one model call at a time: its system text, prompt and reply. Right now no Exchange is selected, so none of that content is included in what I can see.

The Assistant answers only from the data on the current screen, and a **selected** item is what a Question is about. Without a selection I would have nothing to describe, and guessing at the contents of an Exchange could mislead you. If you open an Exchange, I can describe what its system text, prompt and reply contain. I treat that text as a record of another model call, so I describe it and never follow instructions inside it.

Generally, every model call on the platform is kept as an LLM Exchange. The engine owns every number, and language models only explain engine figures and cite Report passages. This is why there are no figures or Report passages to cite in this answer.
